scientific_integrity: The general cubic two-to-one correspondence is proved by original incidence-profile reasoning and verified by standalone direct finite checks. Earlier efficient-domination theorems and an earlier prism-only strong-majority result are credited, not reasserted as discoveries. No claim of independent verification or historical uniqueness is made.
scientific_limitations: The bijection is for finite connected simple cubic graphs with a fixed named two-colour palette. It does not determine which code-free cubic graphs require three versus four strong-majority colours. The power-of-two vertex-transitive classification uses Knor and Potočnik (2012) as a fully credited input. The Möbius exact count relies on their proved propagation lemma; comprehensive historical priority has not been independently established.
title: Perfect-code rigidity of two-colour strong-majority edge colourings of cubic graphs
